response: ["The condition group routed to is melanoma (MEL).","Guidelines exist for the management of melanoma.","For the initial local management of melanoma, surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.","Surgical margins for melanoma should be based on tumor thickness.","Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma and, when possible, in the same operative setting.","When melanoma is suspected, the entire lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to allow histological diagnosis.","Incisional biopsies may be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions.","The recommendation for excision with narrow margins has a consensus rate of 100 % (21/21).","The recommendations are supported by literature cited with PMID 30392755 and PMID 39709737."]
